title: Water Tanks
description: Sandy Water Tank Points. 9 point features, mirrored as GeoParquet in EPSG:3566 (NAD83(HARN) / Utah Central (ftUS)) with Web Mercator vector tiles for display. See the [agent guide](AGENTS.md) for the schema, the coded-value lists and queries that run.

Sandy City GIS, the publisher of this layer
Licence status: Sandy City states no licence

table:columns.name: OBJECTID
table:columns.description: Esri object identifier. A row number assigned by the source geodatabase and reassigned when the layer is republished. It is not a stable key and must not be used to join across collections or across refreshes.

table:columns.name: PubUtils.PU.SandyTanks_Points.AREA
table:columns.description: AREA. Measured in the published file: Populated on 78% of 9 rows, 1 distinct values.

table:columns.name: PERIMETER
table:columns.description: Polygon perimeter carried as an attribute, in the units of the source coordinate system. Recompute from the geometry rather than trusting it. Measured in the published file: Populated on 78% of 9 rows, 1 distinct values.

table:columns.name: SANDY_TANKS_
table:columns.description: Sandy City publishes no definition for this column, and the source layer declares no coded-value domain for it. Measured in the published file: Populated on 100% of 9 rows, 9 distinct values, ranging 2 to 12.

table:columns.name: SANDY_TANKS_ID
table:columns.description: Sandy City publishes no definition for this column, and the source layer declares no coded-value domain for it. Measured in the published file: Populated on 100% of 9 rows, 9 distinct values, ranging 2 to 12.

table:columns.name: TANK_NAME
table:columns.description: Name of the storage tank.

table:columns.name: LOCATION
table:columns.description: Street address or place description of the feature. Measured in the published file: Populated on 100% of 9 rows, 9 distinct values.

table:columns.name: CAPACITY
table:columns.description: Nominal capacity, written with its unit, such as `5 MG` for five million gallons.

table:columns.name: FLOOR_EL
table:columns.description: Elevation of the tank floor, in feet.

table:columns.name: GROUND_EL
table:columns.description: Ground elevation at the tank, in feet.

table:columns.name: OVER_EL
table:columns.description: Overflow elevation, in feet. The difference from ground level sets the pressure the tank delivers.

table:columns.name: OVER_DEPTH
table:columns.description: Water depth at overflow, in feet.

table:columns.name: DIMENSIONS
table:columns.description: Physical dimensions of the tank.

table:columns.name: ZONE_
table:columns.description: Water pressure zone the tank serves, joining to `water-pressure-zones`.

table:columns.name: CONST_TYPE
table:columns.description: Construction type of the tank, such as concrete or steel.

table:columns.name: YEAR_CONST
table:columns.description: Year the tank was built.

table:columns.name: MGCAPACITY
table:columns.description: Capacity in millions of gallons, as a number.

table:columns.name: ENGINEER
table:columns.description: Engineering firm that designed the tank.

table:columns.name: CONTRACTOR
table:columns.description: Contractor that built the tank.

table:columns.name: MAINT_DATE
table:columns.description: Date of the last recorded maintenance.

table:columns.name: MAINT_TYPE
table:columns.description: Type of the last recorded maintenance.

table:columns.name: X_COORD
table:columns.description: X coordinate copied into an attribute. The geometry is authoritative.

table:columns.name: Y_COORD
table:columns.description: Y coordinate copied into an attribute.

table:columns.name: FACILITYID
table:columns.description: Identifier of the asset in the city's maintenance management system. Stable within that system, and the key field crews use. Measured in the published file: Populated on 100% of 9 rows, 9 distinct values.

table:columns.name: POLYGONID
table:columns.description: Identifier carried over from an earlier coverage format. Measured in the published file: Populated on 78% of 9 rows, 1 distinct values.

table:columns.name: SCALE
table:columns.description: Cartographic scale the symbol is drawn at on the city's own maps. Measured in the published file: Populated on 78% of 9 rows, 1 distinct values.

table:columns.name: ANGLE
table:columns.description: Rotation angle of the symbol on the city's own maps. Measured in the published file: Populated on 78% of 9 rows, 1 distinct values.

table:columns.name: Enabled
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source layer's domain allows: `False`, `True`. Codes: `0` = False, `1` = True.

table:columns.name: AncillaryRole
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source layer's domain allows: `None`, `Source`, `Sink`. Codes: `0` = None, `1` = Source, `2` = Sink.

table:columns.name: CONST_STATUS
table:columns.description: Construction status of the asset. Measured in the published file: Populated on 11% of 9 rows, 1 distinct values.

table:columns.name: created_user
table:columns.description: Username of the staff member who created the row, from the geodatabase editor tracking.

table:columns.name: created_date
table:columns.description: Timestamp when the row was created, from the geodatabase editor tracking. It records the database edit, not when the feature was built in the world.

table:columns.name: last_edited_user
table:columns.description: Username of the staff member who last edited the row, from the geodatabase editor tracking.

table:columns.name: last_edited_date
table:columns.description: Timestamp when the row was last edited, from the geodatabase editor tracking. It records the database edit, not a change in the world.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Feature geometry, WKB encoded, in the collection's `proj:epsg` coordinate system.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: Per-row bounding box written by gpio, as a struct of `xmin`, `ymin`, `xmax`, `ymax`, in the same coordinate system as the geometry. Rows are in Hilbert order, so filtering on this column prunes row groups efficiently.
